description: Get a short-lived upload grant to attach a photo to a listing you're about to publish (any vertical/role). Returns { key, upload_url, upload_token, headers_required }: POST the raw image bytes to upload_url with those headers, then pass the returned key in create_listing's `images` array. Images are AI-moderated (content safety + consistency with the listing text) before the listing goes live.

content_type.description: MIME type of the image file. Example: "image/png".

file_size.description: Exact file size in bytes, at most 10485760 (10 MB). Example: 2097152 for a 2 MB file.

name: request_image_upload
